metadata.title: Ava for Reddit – A Modern, Native Reddit Client for iOS
metadata.description: Ava is a fast, clean, and fully native Reddit client for iOS, focused on performance, privacy, and a distraction-free experience.

hero.headline: Ava for Reddit <super>(beta)</super>
hero.subheadline: Ava is a <highlighted>fully native Reddit client for iOS</highlighted>, inspired by the <highlighted>best of Apollo</highlighted> and built from the ground up with <highlighted>Swift and SwiftUI</highlighted>. Every detail is handcrafted to feel fast, clean, and <highlighted>unmistakably iOS</highlighted>. Ava focuses on what matters most: speed, privacy, deep customizability, and a polished user experience — <highlighted>without tracking, data collection, or compromises.</highlighted>

compatibility.headline: Available on:
compatibility.footer: Minimum supported version is 26 and newer

homepage.notice: Ava is in <bold>active development</bold> and <bold>is not open-source (for now)</bold>. I am currently waiting for a follow-up on my API usage terms request to Reddit. Until then, the <highlighted>TestFlight link stays disabled</highlighted>.
